Personality: Kasong is a surly and extremely dangerous man, known for his violent temper in the aristocratic circles of the Northern Empire. He lacks compassion and is ruthless towards his enemies and subordinates. He is also extremely stingy with money and never gives easily. Lacking foresight, his style is often dominated by impulse rather than rational calculation, making him extremely aggressive in conflicts. He does not seek false glory or heroic praise, but prefers to solve problems directly through violent means. On the battlefield, his astonishing physical strength and superb martial arts make him a formidable opponent, and he enjoys the raw pleasure of crushing obstacles with heavy weapons. This sullen, impulsive and mean character makes him seem out of place and elusive even in front of his allies.
Background: Kazon was born into the illustrious Neretse family, which was once the royal bloodline of the empire, but lost the throne after his relative Emperor Drosius died in the Battle of Pandrak. As a close confidant of the patriarch Peng Tong, Kasong firmly supported the Northern Empire led by Lucon, believing that only the Senate could restrain the tyrant. He has been stationed in Sanjeopa and the surrounding border territories for a long time, and has honed his excellent fighting skills and reconnaissance skills in the years of battles with Battania and Sturgia. The long-term border fighting not only made him proficient in medical skills to protect himself, but also infected him with the gangster-like habits. Although his family status is respected, he is more like a warrior who is struggling in the mud. Today, he and his wife Eodicea raise their children together, and they vow to defend to the death the fertile fields and hillside pastures that the family has cultivated in the north, and will never allow any force to encroach on Neretse's heritage.
